text:
jose-peopleops: Heads-up: noticed a spike in 'scorecard mismatch' errors during today's bulk schedule window. A few interviewers reported they couldn't find the right rubric while interviewing.

priya-recruiting: How many interviews affected? any common source (manual vs bulk)?

jose-peopleops: Initial query shows 42 interviews between 08:00-11:00 created by the new bulk-import job. The scheduler logs show an unresolved template version.

liu-eng: sample event from scheduler logs: `ERROR scheduler.assign: template_lookup failed template=backend-v3.1 reason=VersionNotFound`. We recently promoted backend-v3.0 -> v3.1 in the rubric-service but left the legacy alias mapping out of the import pipeline.

mira-interviewer: I noticed on two panels the UI showed "Choose a rubric" even though the invite body included a link to "Backend rubric v3". Interviewers were confused mid-interview.

priya-recruiting: That's bad for consistency. We rely on structured feedback to compare candidates. Plan request: (1) stop-gap: auto-assign a fallback template for affected interviews (v3.0), (2) fix the import pipeline to resolve alias -> current version, (3) backfill historic interviews in the next 48h created by bulk import.

auditor-bot: [audit] 2026-11-09T09:12:01Z INFO missing_template_events count=42 service=scheduler job=bulk-import-20261109

liu-eng: Fix: mapping lambda forgot to consult `template_aliases` table for legacy names. I'll push a patch that checks aliases when a direct lookup fails and returns the canonical id. ETA ~35m to prod after approvals.

sam-ops: While that patch is in QA, we can run a backfill to assign v3.0 as a fallback for interviews with missing templates starting within 72h. Is that acceptable from a compliance/audit perspective?

jose-peopleops: Yes as long as we tag the change and notify interviewers. Please include audit metadata and an explanatory note on the interview. Also coordinate with recruiting before patching candidate-facing invites.

liu-eng: Understood. Backfill script will: select interviews WHERE created_by='bulk-import' AND template_lookup_failed=true AND start_time >= now() AND start_time < now()+72h; then call scheduler.assign_scorecard(interview_id, 'backend-v3.0') and append note "auto-assigned fallback v3.0 due to template alias resolution; will be reconciled when mapping restored". It will add audit tag `scorecard-fallback-20261109` and log the operator. Dry-run shows 42 rows.

auditor-bot: [audit] 2026-11-09T09:43:10Z INFO backfill_dryrun matched=42 job=scorecard-fallback-20261109 user=liu-eng

priya-recruiting: Please also send a short message to interviewers in the patched invites: "We've assigned a fallback rubric to ensure you can submit feedback. If you'd prefer the new v3.1, we'll update it automatically once mapping is fixed." Keep it candidate-safe.

mira-interviewer: Thanks. For transparency, could the note include a link to the rubric comparison doc? Eg: https://docs.redwood.com/rubrics/backend-v3-changes so interviewers know what's different.

jose-peopleops: Good idea. Use the public doc shortlink. Avoid internal-only links.

liu-eng: Deploying patch now to add alias-resolution in mapping. Will run integration test, then deploy to prod. If prod goes well we'll run the backfill immediately.

auditor-bot: [deploy-bot] 2026-11-09T10:05:00Z user=liu-eng env=prod change=hotfix->mapping.alias-resolution

liu-eng: Prod deploy succeeded. Running backfill with audit tag.

auditor-bot: [audit] 2026-11-09T10:20:05Z INFO backfill_run started user=liu-eng matched=42 job=scorecard-fallback-20261109

sam-ops: Backfill completed. 42 interviews patched. Each invite got a note: "Fallback rubric v3.0 assigned; mapping restored to support v3.1 aliases. For details: https://docs.redwood.com/rubrics/backend-v3-changes" Audit tag `scorecard-fallback-20261109` added.

priya-recruiting: Spot-checked 10 patches across teams: rubrics visible and interviewers can submit feedback. Sending a short FYI to interviewing-roster: "If you see the fallback note and prefer v3.1, reply to this thread and we'll update your panel."

mira-interviewer: I appreciate the quick response. One small ask: can we add a small banner in the scheduler UI for 24h that says "Template alias resolution restored; some interviews may have fallback rubrics" so recruiters and interviewers don't get surprised?

jose-peopleops: Good UX touch. Can we do a temporary banner? Sam?

sam-ops: Yep, can add a 24h banner scoped to people-ops and recruiting channels in the UI. Will also add a monitor: alert if template_lookup failures > 3 in 1h.

liu-eng: Also adding unit tests to mapping lambda to assert alias resolution and an integration test against a sample ATS export that uses legacy names. Putting a mapping-schema check into the CI pipeline so similar regressions are caught pre-deploy.

auditor-bot: [audit] 2026-11-09T11:02:43Z INFO actions_completed backfill=42 deploy=success monitor_created=banner_24h alert_rule=template_lookup_threshold

priya-recruiting: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short retro note: better versioning + clearer alias table ownership.

mira-interviewer: All good from my side. Thanks for handling quickly.

jose-peopleops: Closing this incident — resolved and monitored. If anything else crops up ping #people-ops. :white_check_mark:
